test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution mentions about the qualification for membership of the State Legislature?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Article 173.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 173 **defines the **qualification **to become the **member of Legislative Assembly**.
 
• The qualfication are:
 
 
• He/she shall be the citizen of India
 
• He/she shall be of age more than 25
 
• He/she can hold office of profit mention by government of India.
 
• He/she should of healthy sound and mind
 
 
 
• Article 173 comes in **Part-VI **under **Chapter-III **namely **"The States" **of Indian Constitution.
 
• **The States** chapter outlines the composition, powers, and functions of the legislative bodies __within the states of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Article 179: **deals with **the Speaker and Deputy Speaker **of **State Legislature**; their vacation of seat, resignation and removal __from office.
 
• **Article 171: **deals with the Composition of **Legislative Council **in state.
 
• **Article 180: ** deals with the **functioning of role of Speaker and Deputy Speaker of Legislative Assembly in their absence **in office. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• Likewise the Rajya Sabha in Centre, the Parliament can create or dismissed legislative Council for any state under article 169. 
 
• 
 
The Legislative Council, also known as the Vidhan Parishad, is the upper house in state legislature.
